notes.title: World update is now out!
notes.content:
[h1]World update is now out![/h1]

[h2]What's new with this update?[/h2]
[list]
[*]10 new maps
[*]50+ new skins
[*]Improved surfing mechanics
[*]New maps have an animated skybox!
[/list]


[h2]New maps[/h2]
[h3]Bhop[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Egypt map
[*]UAE map
[*]China map
[*]France map
[*] the Netherlands
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40755745/f45adbde239022fcf69b2f82ca882241fd50e822.png[/img]
[h3]Surf[/h3]
[olist]
[*] the Alps, Italy map
[*]Antarctica map
[*]Turkey map
[*]USA map
[*]Japan map
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40755745/cc1952028810b0fd6d121666f1d580441b24d718.png[/img]
[h2]Improved surfing mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*]Surfing now feels better
[*]You don't lose much speed when switching ramps
[*]You gain more speed on ramps!
[/list]
[h2]Couple of the new skins[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40755745/e2e7db19726c7a8da458a72bcf9556af8503612c.png[/img]

notes.title: Beta 1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40755745/8a16e720966e57fa22fed191676fec6c0a398c71.png[/img]
[h1]The update is now live![/h1]
[h2]
Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] - Surfing improved and it is now smoother and feels better
[*] - Your time won't be uploaded as it is unfair
[/list]

[h2]Look out for:[/h2]
- The surfing levels aren't yet adjusted to the new mechanics so they may feel unnatural/incorrect.

[list]
[*] How to play the beta:
[/list]
[b]Go to your steam library and opt in there in the settings.[/b]

notes.title: What's next for BSurfing?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40755745/d652fcdae71ca0cdd02622d85b5a01a2e7a5b6e3.png[/img]
[i][u][h2]Hi everyone! [/h2][/u][/i]
[h1]The launch was a big success, thanks to everyone![/h1]
Through feedback I have realised that the surfing part wasn't as great as the bhop, so I'm going to improve surfing. 

[b]Teaser of the upcoming update![/b]
[h2][b]First content update: [i]The World Update[/i][/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Featuring 50+ new skins (knives with countries from all around the world)
[*] 5 new bhop maps, each map will be themed after a city from around the world.
[*] 5 new surf maps, each map will be themed after a city from around the world.
[/list]

[h3][b]A beta will be soon announced and live with the new surfing mechanics[/b][/h3]


[i][h3]What's coming to BSurfing in the future:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Multiplayer
[*] And a level editor with workshop support
[/list][/i]

Till next time!

notes.title: Update version 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Leaderboard bugs:
[list]
[*] - Leaderboard didn't load if you didn't complete the level. Now it does load as it should.
[/list]

[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*] - Tab is highlighted blue to be more clear where you currently are.
[/list]

New Features:
- Click on anyone on the leaderboards and their profile will open!
Leaderboards should now work completely

notes.title: Update version 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[olist]

[*] - Profile tab text fixed
[/olist]

[b]New feature:[/b]
